{{Quote|If justice is blind, then Judgment must surely be deaf &mdash; considering all the pain and suffering they've caused &hellip;|New Republic official|<ref name="PA" />}}
'''Judgment''' was a part of the [[Order]] branch of the [[Pentastar Alignment]]. Their principal agents were the [[Great InQuestor of Judgment|Great InQuestors of Judgment]] who were responsible for maintaining the decrees of the Alignment.

When creating the Pentastar Alignment, former [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] determined that the Judgment should become a symbol of the Alignment. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kaine was concerned with the lack of a visible organization to uphold the mandates of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Little was done to promote adherence to these values outside of the efforts of [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR's]] [[Coalition for Progress/Legends|Coalition for Progress]]. Kaine was inspired by the Coalition's [[Justice (department)/Legends|Justice Branch]], and how it tried to mesh the policies of the New Order with the legal system, and created Judgement.<ref name="PA">{{JournalCite|3|The Pentastar Alignment}}</ref>

The Empire established that fear by image and deed is far more powerful than fear alone. This maxim directly inspired the sinister appearance of Judgement's emblem and its representatives. The [[Great InQuestor of Judgment|Great InQuestors of Judgement]] were former Imperial [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]] who wore long black cloaks and oversized hoods that hid their faces. These threatening men served as the principal tool of maintaining the decree of the Pentastar Alignment. They were accompanied by their own cadre of [[Protectorate (Pentastar Alignment)|Protectorate]] [[Guardian (Protectorate)|troops]] who sought out miscreants and lawbreakers for cross examination.<ref name="PA" />
